dataset_name: CargoTrack East Africa Freight Delay Dataset
description: Synthetic training dataset for freight delay prediction on East Africa trade routes. Generated from a probabilistic model calibrated to match World Bank LPI delay statistics for the East Africa Community (EAC) region.
source: CargoTrack Logistics Intelligence Platform — synthetic open dataset
positive_class_description: 1 = shipment arrived after scheduled arrival time

distance_km.description: Great-circle road distance of the route in kilometres.

estimated_hours.description: Planned journey duration in hours at the time of dispatch.

weight_kg.description: Total cargo weight in kilograms including packaging.

hour_of_departure.description: Hour of day (24-hour clock) at which the shipment departed.
hour_of_departure.note: Night departures (22–4) and peak-hour departures (7–9, 17–19) have higher risk.

month.note: Kenya rainy seasons: March–May (long rains), October–November (short rains).

route_origin.values: East Africa city names (see CITIES list in generator source)

num_tracking_events.description: Number of tracking events logged during the shipment.
num_tracking_events.note: Fewer events may indicate GPS/comms issues correlated with delays.

has_customs_stop.description: Whether the route crosses an international border requiring customs.

carrier_on_time_rate.description: Historical on-time delivery rate of the carrier [0–1].

is_rainy_season.description: Whether the departure month falls in East Africa's rainy season.
is_rainy_season.note: Rainy months: 3, 4, 5, 10, 11. Road damage and flooding significantly increase delays.

road_condition_score.description: Composite road quality score for the primary route (1=poor, 5=excellent).

num_stops.description: Number of planned intermediate stops (e.g. warehouse pick-ups, depots).

is_weekend_departure.description: Whether the departure was on a Saturday or Sunday.
is_weekend_departure.note: Weekend departures may face reduced port/border staffing.

border_crossings.description: Number of international border crossings on the route.

delayed.description: Target variable. 1 = shipment arrived after the scheduled arrival time.
